review:
Big Bass Bonanza 3 Reeler squeezes the franchise into a compact 3x3 grid with five paylines. The symbols are classic Big Bass – rods, dragonflies and fish – but the smaller layout makes the base game feel closer to a quick retro slot. Pragmatic Play still packs in a 5,000x win potential.

Three scatters award at least 10 free spins. Every fisherman collects the cash values of all visible fish, and if he lands with no fish on screen, the Big Bazooka feature can fire random cash symbols across the grid. Every fourth fisherman adds 10 more spins and steps the multiplier up, to a maximum of 10x. With only nine positions, each fish and fisherman matters more, so bonuses can swing quickly. The RTP is 96.5%.
